INSERT INTO sub_mine_development_data( mine_development_dataID, unit_nameJSON,unit_code, production_data, expand_data, footage_data, enter_well_num, come_out_well_num ) VALUES
(#{it.mineDevelopmentDataID}, #{it.unitNameJSON}, #{it.unitCode}, #{it.productionData}, #{it.expandData}, #{it.footageData}, #{it.enterWellNum}, #{it.comeOutWellNum})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sub_mine_development_data WHERE mine_development_dataID IN #{id} ORDER BY mine_development_dataID ASC, id ASC

SELECT t2.unit_nameJSON,t2.unit_code,sum(t2.production_data) as production_data ,sum(t2.expand_data) as expand_data,sum(t2.footage_data) as footage_data,sum(t2.enter_well_num) as enter_well_num ,sum(t2.come_out_well_num) as come_out_well_num FROM mine_development_data t1 left join sub_mine_development_data t2 on t1.id =t2.mine_development_dataID where t1.unit_code=#{unitCode} and t1.is_deleted=0 and t2.unit_nameJSON !='' and t1.record_date=#{recordDate} GROUP BY t2.unit_nameJSON,t2.unit_code

SELECT t2.unit_nameJSON,t2.unit_code,sum(t2.production_data) as production_data ,sum(t2.expand_data) as expand_data,sum(t2.footage_data) as footage_data,sum(t2.enter_well_num) as enter_well_num ,sum(t2.come_out_well_num) as come_out_well_num FROM mine_development_data t1 left join sub_mine_development_data t2 on t1.id =t2.mine_development_dataID where t1.unit_code=#{unitCode} and t1.is_deleted=0 and t2.unit_nameJSON !='' and YEAR(t1.record_date) =YEAR(#{recordDate}) and MONTH(t1.record_date) = MONTH(#{recordDate}) AND t1.record_date <= #{recordDate} GROUP BY t2.unit_nameJSON,t2.unit_code

SELECT t2.unit_nameJSON,t2.unit_code,sum(t2.production_data) as production_data ,sum(t2.expand_data) as expand_data,sum(t2.footage_data) as footage_data,sum(t2.enter_well_num) as enter_well_num ,sum(t2.come_out_well_num) as come_out_well_num FROM mine_development_data t1 left join sub_mine_development_data t2 on t1.id =t2.mine_development_dataID where t1.unit_code=#{unitCode} and t1.is_deleted=0 and t2.unit_nameJSON !='' AND t1.record_date <= #{recordDate} and YEAR(t1.record_date) =YEAR(#{recordDate}) GROUP BY t2.unit_nameJSON,t2.unit_code

SELECT t1.data_type AS unit_nameJSON,sum(t2.production_data) as production_data ,sum(t2.expand_data) as expand_data,sum(t2.footage_data) as footage_data,sum(t2.enter_well_num) as enter_well_num ,sum(t2.come_out_well_num) as come_out_well_num FROM mine_development_data t1 LEFT JOIN sub_mine_development_data t2 ON t1.id = t2.mine_development_dataID WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 and t2.unit_nameJSON='合计' AND t1.record_date = #{recordDate} -- 替换别名，使用原字段t1.data_type GROUP BY t1.data_type -- 与SELECT非聚合列保持一致
